label: Probability
shortDescription: A free university probability course: the axioms, conditional probability and Bayes, random variables, joint distributions, expectation and conditioning, generating functions, the limit theorems, and Markov chains.
modulesDescription: Read the probability chapters in order, or jump straight to the distribution you need.
courseDescription: A complete university probability course, free and worked from the axioms. Build the subject from Kolmogorov's three axioms through conditional probability and Bayes' theorem, random variables and their distributions, and on to stochastic processes — with every result proved rather than asserted.
ogDescription: Learn probability from the axioms up: conditional probability, Bayes, random variables, distributions and stochastic processes, with full proofs and practice.

topics.title: Foundations of Probability
topics.description: Sample spaces and events, the Kolmogorov axioms and the rules derived from them, counting, conditional probability, independence, total probability and Bayes' theorem.

topics.title: Random Variables and Discrete Distributions
topics.description: Random variables, PMFs, expected value, binomial, Poisson, and geometric distributions.

topics.title: Continuous Random Variables
topics.description: PDFs, CDFs, normal, exponential, and uniform distributions.

topics.title: Joint Distributions
topics.description: Two or more random variables on one probability space: joint pmfs and densities, marginals, independence, conditional distributions, the bivariate normal, and sums by convolution.

topics.title: Expectation, Covariance and Conditional Expectation
topics.description: Covariance and correlation, the Cauchy-Schwarz bound, conditional expectation as a random variable, the tower property, the law of total variance, best prediction, and Jensen's inequality.

topics.title: Transformations and Generating Functions
topics.description: Functions of random variables by the cdf method and Jacobians, convolution, order statistics, and moment and probability generating functions.

topics.title: Inequalities and Limit Theorems
topics.description: Markov, Chebyshev, Cantelli and Chernoff bounds; Jensen's inequality; the four modes of convergence and the implications between them; the weak and strong laws of large numbers; and the central limit theorem with Berry-Esseen and the delta method.

topics.title: Markov Chains
topics.description: The Markov property and transition matrices, Chapman-Kolmogorov, classification of states, stationary distributions and convergence, reversibility, absorption and hitting times.

topics.title: Poisson Processes and Brownian Motion
topics.description: Markov chains, Poisson processes, Brownian motion, and basic time series.
